statement.zh: 法国队于 1877–1933 年在特罗（吉尔苏）进行约二十次发掘战役；Parrot 1948 年专著综合其战役史与已刊发现。
statement.en: French teams conducted about twenty excavation campaigns at Tello (Girsu) between 1877 and 1933; Parrot 1948 synthesizes campaign history and published finds.

editorial.notes: Fact about excavation history as synthesized by Parrot.
